items.title: What if less selling time had been lost to rain?
items.description: The bake sale actually lost about half its selling time to rain and raised $340 of the $500 goal. Drag the slider to see what a fuller selling window would have raised, assuming sales kept the same steady pace throughout — the dashed line marks what actually happened.
items.compute: const fullPotential = 680; const raised = Math.round(fullPotential * (1 - params.timeLostPercent / 100)); return { raised };
